direction.comments: The direction on a macroscale feels like a DCOM, just with a bigger budget, that is a teen movie from the early 00s; the direction on a microscale is pretty good as the scenes between Curtis and Lohan make this movie really entertaining as their dynamic is what make's this movie worth watching, the remaining macroscale moments are just typical 2000s teen movie, DCOM moments; the storytelling is very much a 2000s teen movie mixed with DCOM elements; tension is pretty forced

performance.comments: Her chemistry with Lohan really makes this movie as both are two halves to an entertaining duo that make this movie fun and interesting
Her chemistry with Lee Curtis really makes this movie as both are two halves to an entertaining duo that make this movie fun and interesting

cast.comments: Generic background DCOM style actors, what you would expect from a movie like this

story.comments: The concept is a retelling of its source material and original movie, but has become more iconic than the originals as the two lead performances are really one as they effortlessly switch between two difference characters; the plot structure is simple and formulaic as its what you would expect from a 2000s Disney Movie; character writing is suprisingly good as they provide depth to the two lead characters to make you care about them, and do a pretty good job showing the personalities of the two lead characters as they switch bodies

screenplay.comments: The dialogue very much feels like a DCOM with a bigger budget, but is still entertaining; the dialogue is very much of the time as it makes this movie feel like a 2000s teen movie; the humor is pretty stuck in it's time period, but is still somewhat funny and makes this movie entertaining; the symbolism is pretty forced and formaulic, but still profound as it targets families of all ages; the foreshadowing makes this movie incredibly obvious, considering this is a Disney family movie

score.comments: Makes this movie feel VERY 2000s Teen movie

soundtrack.comments: Makes this movie feel VERY 2000s Teen movie

cinematography.comments: Makes this movie feel VERY 2000s Teen movie, especially with a lot of the fast then stop cuts they use

editing.comments: Makes this movie feel VERY 2000s Teen movie, especially with a lot of the hip-hop edits and transitions they use

costumes.comments: The wardrobe is very much of the time-period as it shoves in your face that this very much is a early 2000s teen movie

review.pacing: Pacing is on the faster side as this movie is only 90 minutes, which made it perfect to watch on a plane
review.climax: Climax is very much what you would expect from a movie that feels like a DCOM, but it is still heartwarming and works well enough for the film
review.tone: Tone is very much a early 2000s teen movie that is basically a DCOM with a bigger budget
review.overall: Overall, a pretty good movie that only works because of Lindsay Lohan and Jamie Lee Curtis' strong chemistry because it's basically a DCOM with a bigger budget
